about: Fixed table behind the indicator_map tool (Project Report v3.0, section 8.1). It maps a reason family or a novelty flag on an alert to the typologies the FinGuard playbook lists for it, the checks the playbook suggests, and knowledge-base queries. It is a lookup, not a model: it never reads the transaction and never decides anything. Typologies are what the indicators are 'consistent with', never a finding. Changing this file changes agent behaviour: bump 'version' and re-run the agent evaluation.

flag_burst_first_day.label: Burst of transactions within 24 h of the proxy entity's first transaction
checks: Compare the amounts, products and devices of the burst, and check whether earlier transactions in the burst were declined or disputed.

queries.query: several transactions on the proxy entity within minutes or hours card testing

entity_velocity.label: Proxy-entity velocity
checks: Compare the amounts, products and devices of the recent transactions on the proxy entity.

queries.query: several transactions on the proxy entity within minutes or hours card testing

entity_history.label: Proxy-entity history
checks: Review the proxy entity's earlier transactions: time since the previous one, amounts and products.

queries.query: risk indicators for cyber-enabled fraud suspicion in account user's identity

flag_new_device.label: New device brand for the proxy entity
checks: Check whether the device change coincides with a new email domain or a change of shipping details.

queries.query: new device used for the account account takeover indicators

device.label: Device and browser
checks: Compare the device brand and browser with those the proxy entity used before.

queries.query: new device used for the account account takeover indicators

flag_amount_above_max.label: Amount far above the proxy entity's earlier maximum
typologies: stolen card used for high-value goods
checks: Compare the amount and product with the proxy entity's earlier amounts and products; check whether the purchase type changed.

queries.query: amount far above the earlier amounts of the same card account takeover

amount.label: Amount
typologies: stolen card used for high-value goods
checks: Compare the amount with the proxy entity's earlier amounts and with the usual amounts for the product code.

queries.query: amount far above the earlier amounts of the same card account takeover

email.label: Email domains
typologies: stolen card details used by a third party
checks: Check the purchaser and recipient email domains against the domains the proxy entity used before.

queries.query: purchaser and recipient email domains differ anonymous email domain

card.label: Card attributes
checks: Note the card network and type; card-not-present fraud disputes follow the network's rules.

queries.query: Visa dispute condition 10.4 other fraud card-absent environment

address.label: Address and distance codes
checks: Compare the address codes with the proxy entity's earlier transactions; the codes are undisclosed, so only equality can be checked.

queries.query: address verification service for card-absent transactions

completeness.label: Data completeness
checks: Check whether missing identity data is normal for the product code; it is not an indicator on its own.

queries.query: identity record absent and many empty fields

product.label: Product code
checks: Note the product code; the codes are not explained by the data provider.

time.label: Relative time of day
checks: Relative hour only: the data's clock and time zone are unknown, so do not read it as local time.

identity_masked.label: Anonymized identity signals
checks: Anonymized signal group: its meaning is not disclosed and it cannot be verified against the transaction.

counting_C.label: Anonymized counting features
checks: Anonymized signal group: its meaning is not disclosed and it cannot be verified against the transaction.

timedelta_D.label: Anonymized time-delta features
checks: Anonymized signal group: its meaning is not disclosed and it cannot be verified against the transaction.

match_M.label: Match flags
checks: Anonymized signal group: its meaning is not disclosed and it cannot be verified against the transaction.

vesta_V.label: Vesta engineered features
checks: Anonymized signal group: its meaning is not disclosed and it cannot be verified against the transaction.

no_entity_key.label: No proxy entity (card1, addr1 or D1 missing)
checks: Check which of card1, addr1 or D1 is missing; a missing key is not an indicator on its own.

investigate.query: which fraudulent payment transactions must a payment service provider report
escalate to a level-2 investigator or the compliance officer
